description:
Aurora Forecast is your intelligent personal aurora hunting guide — space weather science, Apple's native intelligence, and a live community of aurora watchers, all in your pocket.

— COMMUNITY SIGHTINGS —
See where the aurora is being spotted right now. Live sightings from people near you appear on the map, and "Seen near you" shows how many are watching the lights nearby, updated in real time. Spotted it yourself? Share it with one tap so others know it's happening now. Anonymous by design — no account, and your location is coarsened for privacy.

— AI AURORA ANALYST (Apple Intelligence) —
Aurora forecasting means decoding solar wind speed, interplanetary magnetic fields, and Kp indices. Now you don't have to. Our AI Aurora Analyst, powered by Apple Intelligence, processes all of that and delivers a clear, personalized "Go/No-Go" verdict based on your exact location and local weather. One glance answers the only question that matters: "Can I see it tonight?"

— WIDGETS & APPLE WATCH COMPLICATIONS —
Never miss a geomagnetic storm. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets deliver real-time Kp-index updates at a glance. Apple Watch complications let you track activity right from your wrist — perfect for quick checks when you're already out in the field.

— CORE FEATURES —
• Live community sightings near you
• NOAA OVATION Aurora Forecast Model
• Real-time solar wind & geomagnetic activity data
• Interactive aurora probability map
• 3D globe with real-time aurora visualization
• Live aurora webcams & Sun imagery
• Multi-day Kp-index forecast charts
• Customizable push notifications for geomagnetic storms
• Dark sky location finder
• Apple Watch app with complications
• 30+ languages supported

Whether you're a seasoned aurora chaser or hoping to see the Northern Lights for the first time, Aurora Forecast puts real-time space weather and a live community of aurora watchers in your pocket.
